notes: A one-page 1887 financial statement (a ledger-style list with dot leaders and large figures). All 35 labels match the print, including polytonic marks, figures like 170,000,000 and 41,945,012, and the French bank name 'Comptoir d'Escompte' (18, 23, 28), which is genuinely printed in Latin type. The flags reflect the genre (digit-heavy, one French-named line, few admitted lines), not label errors. One trivial slip: line 2 ends 'ται' where the print has the hyphenated 'τα-'.
